prerequisites: Completion of all courses and internships provided in the curriculum (obtaining the so-called 'absolutorium')
Positive evaluation of the diploma thesis by its supervisor.

learning_outcomes.text: Possesses knowledge in the studied area of electrical engineering: power engineering, control systems and measurement systems.
Has knowledge about development trends in their studied area of electrical engineering and knowledge of methods and technologies used in the design and creation of electrical devices.
Can acquire, integrate and interpret information, conduct analyses, interpret their results and formulate conclusions.
Can prepare documentation related to the execution of an engineering task and prepare a text containing a discussion of the results of this task.
Can prepare and present a short presentation dedicated to the results of the engineering task.
Is able to specify their interests and choose the topic of the diploma thesis.
Is aware of the consequences of copyright infringement.

syllabus_topics: All issues related to the chosen topic of the diploma thesis
assessment_rules: The diploma thesis is evaluated independently by the supervisor and the reviewer. The supervisor decides on admitting the thesis for review. In case of discrepancies between the supervisor's and reviewer's grades, the final grade for the thesis is determined at the diploma examination committee meeting. If the thesis was prepared for the needs of a workplace, the committee also takes into account the opinion of that workplace, if it was expressed in writing. An appeal against a negative evaluation of the thesis by the supervisor can be made by the student within 14 days to the head of the organizational unit where the work is carried out.
bibliography: The scope of literature consistent with the chosen topic of the diploma thesis
